title: KPI tiles with no data and with extreme values
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. Seed via the app: a Revenue range with no parts-versus-labour split; and a report with an extreme value.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm no KPI tile shows a delta indicator (the sparkline is the only comparison).
2. On a Revenue range with no parts/labor split, confirm the supporting line reads '{count} Invoices' instead.
3. With an extreme underlying value, confirm the tile headline still shows the true figure to the report's precision.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • No KPI tile shows a delta indicator; the sparkline is the only comparison.
  • If the Revenue tile has no parts-versus-labor split to show, its supporting line reads "{count} Invoices" instead.
  • If the underlying report has an extreme value, the tile headline still shows the true figure to the report's precision.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9576 (S4 — KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S4; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N1: “No KPI tile shows a delta indicator; the sparkline is the only comparison.”
  • S4-N2: “If the Revenue tile has no parts-versus-labor split to show, its supporting line reads "{count} Invoices" instead.”
  • S4-E1: “If the underlying report has an extreme value, the tile headline still shows the true figure to the report's precision.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
